internal.title: High Kafka Consumer Lag in Accounting Service - Incident Update
internal.body:
At 11:46 UTC, a KafkaConsumerLagHigh alert was triggered for the accounting service due to a backlog of 5200 records and an elevated error rate of 0.12. Initial diagnosis rounds explored error injection hypotheses in checkout and frontend services but were inconclusive or blocked by guardrails. The primary supported hypothesis is a queue backlog in the accounting service causing processing delays and errors. The incident has been escalated for further investigation and resolution.

Timeline highlights:
- 11:46 Alert received
- 12:05 Diagnosis round 1: checkout error injection hypothesis evaluated and rejected
- 12:06 Diagnosis rounds 2 and 3: frontend error injection hypotheses evaluated and rejected
- Guardrails prevented some proposed actions due to dry run missing or target mismatches

Next steps involve deeper investigation into the accounting service's Kafka consumer processing to identify and resolve the backlog.

external.body: Between 11:46 and ongoing, some customers may have experienced delays in processing transactions due to a backlog in the accounting service's message queue. Our engineering team is actively investigating and working to resolve the issue. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience.
